items.title: Jharkhand's rural job scheme and tap-water mission: what the audit record shows and leaves open
items.dek: An audit of two public programmes in Jharkhand examines how funds moved and how work was recorded, but it does not settle what the people who depend on these schemes experienced on the ground.

items.title: Audit finds gaps in PMAY-G record in Jharkhand, but cannot confirm who got houses
items.dek: A new audit of the rural housing scheme in Jharkhand shows that the official records do not prove that the intended beneficiaries were selected or that the houses were built as claimed.
